articles.headline: Six things South Africa need to fix after FIFA World Cup exit
articles.description: South Africa's World Cup can end with pride, as Hugo Broos's side reached the knockout stages for the first time in history, having overcoming an early setback with the opening defeat by Mexico in the process.

articles.headline: How Norway's 'Viking Row' was made, and then took over the World Cup
articles.description: You've seen the viral images of Norway fans and their "Viking Row," the latest in a long tradition of iconic team chants at the World Cup. Only, this one isn't rooted in history, but the notepad of a super-fan.
